name: Egypt

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and black, with a golden Eagle of Saladin in the centre of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: Red recalls the struggle before the 1952 revolution, white the bloodless revolution itself, and black the end of oppression; the eagle is the Eagle of Saladin.

hook: Egypt's red-white-black has a golden eagle in the middle; Iraq writes green Arabic script there and Yemen leaves it blank.
trivia: From 1958 to 1972 Egypt flew a red-white-black flag with two green stars, representing Egypt and Syria in the United Arab Republic.
Between 1972 and 1984 the centre held a golden Hawk of Quraish before the eagle replaced it.
